step: Classical Latin length distinction becomes a quality (tense) distinction, first pass
the length feature is dropped now that quality carries the contrast
word-final nasal consonant lost after an unstressed vowel
a stressed vowel lengthens before a single consonant + glide
the low vowel fronts by default
an unstressed non-low non-nasalized vowel reduces to schwa before a consonant or word end
a word-final stop re-opens to a fricative after a vowel
the ae̯ diphthong monophthongizes to a long e, preserving its stress level
an identical consonant geminate reduces to one (recurrence)
the interdental fricatives (plain and palatalized) efface
stress is leveled — no longer distinctive
